name: Sesame Roasted Chickpea & Veggie Bowl with Quinoa

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup quinoa
473 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
2 crowns broccoli
454 g cremini mushrooms
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Transfer to a large bowl.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine, transfer to a large baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cloves garlic
toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies in the oven and roast until starting to brown, about 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place chickpeas, oil, and soy sauce in the bowl used for the veggies; stir to coat.
Once the veggies are starting to brown, add seasoned chickpeas to the baking sheet; return to the oven and continue to bake until the veggies are fork-tender, 5-7 minutes more.
Place additional soy sauce, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce in the bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp pure maple syrup
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide quinoa between bowls. Top with roasted chickpeas, veggies, and sesame seeds. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
